greeting: Good morning, Zuhair. Here's a lean edition today, with only the stories I could verify and link.

lead.headline: Victorian election enters its final month with health and dental pledges
lead.summary: With the 28 November state election four weeks away, Labor under Premier Ben Carroll and the Coalition are trading spending promises on dental care and worker protections. Polls have Labor trailing.

stories.headline: Why AI models need proper version numbers
stories.summary: A Perspective in Nature Machine Intelligence argues that AI providers often change models without changing their public identifiers, which undermines regulatory oversight and the reproducibility of research. The authors call for meaningful versioning.

stories.headline: Everything that happened in AI on Tuesday 3 November
stories.summary: A daily digest covering election-monitoring teams at OpenAI and Anthropic for the US midterms, rising opposition to data centres, and a string of AI business and policy moves.

stories.headline: Airport rail link submission alleges intimidation and inflated costs
stories.summary: A submission to the construction royal commission reportedly alleges a public servant was pressured over the Melbourne Airport Rail Link project. The government denies the claims.

stories.headline: Victoria's election sideshow is in full swing, but the result is unclear
stories.summary: An analysis of the tough Labor versus Liberal contest as the campaign heats up, with One Nation shaping the race.

thought: A small, true edition beats a big, shaky one.
